name: Professor T
description: Professor Jasper Tempest, a genius Cambridge University criminologist with OCD and an overbearing mother, advises the police. British version of the Belgian crime drama of the same name.

videos.title: The Anatomy of a Memory
videos.overview: Diana Tyson was violently attacked on the university campus where Professor T has tenure. DI Lisa Donckers suspects that the assault is very similar to one that occurred years beforehand, and, having been a previous student of Professor T's, she thinks he can help.

videos.title: A Fish Called Walter
videos.overview: There is a poisoning at a reception. The police start to think that the real target is a civil servant who forged an environmental report who also was present at the reception. Due to the forged report, the daughter of a young family is very sick in hospital. The child's father might have something to do with the death.

videos.title: Tiger Tiger
videos.overview: A jeweller is run down in the street when he crosses in a hurry. In his bag he has a collection of very valuable diamonds. The police suspect there is more to it and visit his family.

videos.title: Mother Love
videos.overview: An au pair comes home after an evening off to find her employer unconscious in the living room. His daughter has vanished. The investigation leads the police to his business partner.

videos.title: Sophie Knows
videos.overview: A girl with Downs Syndrome claims she knows who murdered her mother, but she doesn't want to say who it is. She only trusts the professor. Lisa is worried about her father and Dan has a surprise when he turns up for their date.

videos.title: The Dutiful Child
videos.overview: There is a hit on prominent businessman during an official function. The shooter fails but the intended victim is found dead a few days later. A family feud reminds Jasper of his past

videos.title: Ring of Fire
videos.overview: When a student is left badly burnt and in a coma after a house fire, the CID team call in Professor T after it emerges the victim was drugged.

videos.title: The Mask Murders
videos.overview: A prominent barrister and his wife are found shot dead in a crime that has uncanny similarities to a double murder that the barrister successfully prosecuted 15 years earlier.

videos.title: The Family
videos.overview: The Professor is asked to decipher a macabre puzzle when a doctor and her family are found dead in a grisly tableau on their living room sofa, each having died by different means. But in which order and by whom?

videos.title: DNA of a Murderer
videos.overview: When an artisan baker is found dead after receiving death threats, the police appear to have an open and shut case against the son of a convicted murderer who was sent to prison thanks to the baker's testimony.

videos.title: The Trial
videos.overview: Professor T conducts a series of lectures for his students detailing a high-profile court case in which a caretaker is accused of murdering his employer; the accused was found standing over the victim's body and his fingerprints on the murder weapon, but Professor T is convinced of his innocence, bringing him into conflict with the CID team and DI Paul Rabbits as the investigating officer.

videos.title: Swansong
videos.overview: After discovering the body of an undercover police officer, the CID team blunder into a Drugs Squad operation against a major trafficker that appears to implicate one of their closest colleagues.

videos.title: Heir to the Throne
videos.overview: When Professor T is jailed and finds the sights, sounds and smells of prison hard to take, Dan and Lisa try to distract him with a murder case.

videos.title: The Perfect Picture
videos.overview: When a body is found floating in a hotel swimming pool, the police suspect foul play and decide to get Professor T's help.

videos.title: Truth and Justice
videos.overview: Professor T is up in court and must decide whether to save himself or his former lover, and there are no end of suspects in a prison officer's death.

videos.title: A Little Drop of Poison
videos.overview: Professor T is desperate to get back to his work when he is called on by the police to investigate a series of unexplained deaths.

videos.title: The Conference
videos.overview: Professor T must prove his innocence when he comes under suspicion after a murder at a criminology conference.

videos.title: Attachment Issues
videos.overview: When a body is found at the scene of a car crash, Professor T investigates and finds some uncomfortable resemblances to his own situation.

videos.title: Overboard
videos.overview: A woman mysteriously disappears from a yacht, during a trip with her boyfriend and friends. Dr. Goldberg tries to convince Professor Tempest to resume collaboration with the police.

videos.title: September Gardens
videos.overview: While Jasper visits a home for the elderly, a woman is killed by one of the people living there. But there may be more to the murder than meets the eye.

videos.title: The Inspection
videos.overview: A school inspector is killed, first by five stab wounds, and then by being smothered. Why two different methods?

videos.title: You Can't Kill Me
videos.overview: A stage prop knife is substituted by a real knife. Who did the switch and why?

videos.title: The Perfect Murder
videos.overview: When a painting is destroyed, suspicions fall on a group of climate activists. But the next attack leaves a dead body behind.

videos.title: The Warrior Gene
videos.overview: A man staggers in front of a car, and confesses to killing a man before dying. But where is the body?

videos.title: The things we do for love
